errors.text: The proposed NbTaMoWV alloy is not the target HfNbTaTiZr family and includes Mo and W, which are Group VI rather than Group IV-V elements.
The additive-manufacturing route is fundamentally different: SEBM/LENS of elemental powders replaces hydride-enabled ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, and vacuum sintering.

The interstitial prescription is opposite to the target mechanism: the hypothesis minimizes oxygen below 100 ppm, whereas the target deliberately retains approximately 1.0 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening.
It omits hydride decomposition and its ordered in-situ alloying/oxygen-scavenging mechanism, as well as titanium-sponge oxygen gettering.
It omits water quenching from 1500 degrees C, which is essential for suppressing alpha-HCP formation and retaining metastable single beta-BCC material.
It does not reconstruct the silicide coating or the self-healing Zr/Hf oxide mechanism responsible for the reported oxidation-rate reduction.
